title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: Spyglass, our innovative new platform, is now officially launched and ready to empower you with its full capabilities after a successful beta period.

title: Master Your Media: New File Controls
summary: Take complete command of your images and documents directly within the editor, giving you the power to effortlessly add, remove, and customize their appearance.

title: Introducing Our New Public Roadmap
summary: We're excited to launch our new public roadmap, offering you a clear and transparent look at our completed features, upcoming releases, and future innovations.

title: Elevated Checkbox Experience
summary: Our redesigned checkboxes are now bigger, visually refreshed, and fully draggable, making your task management more intuitive and delightful.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: Experience a new level of teamwork as we've made real-time collaboration smoother and more intuitive than ever before.

title: Seamless Shared Content Discovery
summary: We've enhanced how you discover and engage with shared content from your network, making collaboration effortless and more connected than ever.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: Noeko's codebase is now open source, empowering our community with greater control, direct involvement, and full transparency in the project's future.

title: Speak Your Language
summary: Our new update brings comprehensive international language support, allowing users around the globe to experience Noeko in their native tongue.

title: Elevated Design & Personalized Themes
summary: We're refreshing existing themes and introducing a diverse array of new visual styles, empowering you to personalize your workspace more than ever.

title: Intelligent Constellation View
summary: Experience a revitalized visual knowledge map, now featuring powerful filtering options and collaborative sharing tools to effortlessly explore and manage your entire information universe.

title: Advanced Search & Custom Collections
summary: Discover precisely what you need, faster than ever, with new advanced search filters, flexible sorting options, and the ability to save your custom knowledge collections.

title: Smarter Note Structuring
summary: Organize your thoughts more intuitively with new flexible display options and improved interactivity for your linked notes.

title: Noeko's Official Release with Flexible Hosting Options
summary: We're excited to officially launch Noeko, offering both convenient cloud-hosted and powerful self-hosted options to give you complete control and flexibility.

title: Smarter Time-Based Greetings
summary: We're ensuring your homepage greeting precisely matches the time of day, creating a more personalized and welcoming experience.

title: Streamlined Tag Management
summary: Effortlessly manage your content by directly removing items from tags within the tag view, making organization quicker and more intuitive.

title: Expanded Content Sources
summary: Effortlessly bring in information from a wider array of sources like YouTube videos, websites, and text files, making it easier to consolidate all your valuable content in one place.
